name: DeKalb County School District
districtFact: DeKalb County School District publishes official school calendars for a large Metro Atlanta district where families need to distinguish holidays, breaks, PD days, make-up days, flex days, and grading period boundaries.

about.title: About DeKalb County School District
about.content: DeKalb County School District serves public school students across DeKalb County, Georgia. The district's official calendars list first and last student days, workdays, professional development days, major breaks, make-up days when scheduled, flex days, grading period endings, and semester boundaries.

about.title: District Boundaries and School-Level Schedules
about.content: DeKalb County School District serves many DeKalb County communities, but City Schools of Decatur is a separate school system. The district calendar is also separate from school-level notices for testing, athletics, magnet programs, graduations, transportation updates, and emergency announcements.

planningTips.title: Planning Tips for DeKalb County Families
content: Check whether a no-student date is a holiday, PD day, make-up day, or flex day because each category can affect family planning differently.
Use the official year calendar rather than assuming a standard 180-day summary; DeKalb's published instructional-day count can vary by school year.
Make-up days may be exchanged as student days if weather or another school event requires schedule recovery.
Confirm school-level events, testing, athletics, magnet program dates, graduation details, and bus updates with the assigned school.
Families with work, childcare, or custody arrangements across district lines may want to compare DeKalb dates with Atlanta, Fulton, Gwinnett, and Cobb calendars.

customSections.label: How to Read DeKalb Calendar Terms
customSections.content: The DeKalb calendar uses several labels that are easy to confuse. Holidays and breaks usually mean schools are closed. PD days and workdays are staff-focused days. Make-up days can become student attendance days if the district needs to recover instructional time after weather or another closure.

groups.label: Terms families should check
items: PD Day: professional development or staff planning time with no regular student attendance.
Make-up Day: may become a student day if the district needs to make up instructional time lost to weather or another closure.
Flex Day/PD Day: April 27 is listed under this label on the district calendar. Families should confirm whether the date affects student attendance before making childcare plans.

customSections.label: DeKalb District Calendar vs School-Level Schedules
customSections.content: City Schools of Decatur is a separate school system. The DeKalb district calendar covers systemwide dates, but individual schools may publish separate schedules for testing, athletics, magnet programs, transportation, graduation, and emergency changes.

districtFaqs.q: What school district serves DeKalb County, Georgia?
districtFaqs.a: Most addresses in DeKalb County are served by DeKalb County School District, but City Schools of Decatur is a separate school system. Families should confirm the district and school assigned to their home address.

districtFaqs.q: Does DeKalb County School District include Decatur?
districtFaqs.a: DeKalb County School District serves many DeKalb County communities, but City Schools of Decatur is a separate school system. Families in the Decatur area should verify which district serves their address.

districtFaqs.q: What is a DeKalb make-up day?
districtFaqs.a: A make-up day is a calendar date that may be exchanged as a student day if the district needs to recover time after weather or another school event. If it is not used as a student day, the calendar notes it may be considered a holiday.

districtFaqs.q: Does DeKalb County use professional development days?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. DeKalb calendars list PD days and workdays separately from regular holidays and student attendance days.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify DeKalb County School District calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official DeKalb County School District calendar page and school announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates summarizes official calendar documents and is not affiliated with DeKalb County School District.
